SELECT DISTINCT permission.permission_code FROM sys_user_role AS user_role
INNER JOIN sys_role AS role ON role.id = user_role.role_id
INNER JOIN sys_role_permission AS role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = role.id
INNER JOIN sys_permission AS permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id
WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND role.status = 'ENABLED' AND permission.status = 'ENABLED'
ORDER BY permission.permission_code ASC

INNER JOIN sys_permission AS permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id
WHERE role_permission.role_id = #{roleId} AND permission.status = 'ENABLED'
ORDER BY permission.permission_code ASC
